verses.sloka: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः ।अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनूमांश्च महाकपिः ।। ५.६१.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato jāmbavato vākyamagṛhṇanta vanaukasaḥ ।aṅgadapramukhā vīrā hanūmāṁśca mahākapiḥ ।। 5.61.1 ।।।।

translations.english: In the midst of all the leaders of the monkeys including Angada, Hanuman accepted Jambavan's advice.

verses.sloka: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपुरस्सराः ।महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः ।। ५.६१.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: prītimantastataḥ sarve vāyuputrapurassarāḥ ।mahendrādriṁ parityajya pupluvuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ ।। 5.61.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

verses.sloka: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः ।छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः ।। ५.६१.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: merumandarasaṅkāśā mattā iva mahāgajāḥ ।chādayanta ivākāśaṁ mahākāyā mahābalāḥ ।। 5.61.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.
translations.hindi: सीता को रावण के रनवासं में रोक रखा जाना, राक्षसियों द्वारा डराया- घमकाया जाना, श्रीरामचन्द्रजी में सीता के अनुराग ग्रौर रावण द्वारा सीता के मारे जाने की भ्रवधि नियत किया जाना

verses.sloka: सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम् ।हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः ।। ५.६१.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sabhājyamānaṁ bhūtaistamātmavantaṁ mahābalam ।hanūmantaṁ mahāvegaṁ vahanta iva dṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 5.61.4 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.
translations.hindi: यह समस्त वृत्तान्त श्री रामचन्द्रजी से उन वानरों ने कहा । सीताजी को राजीखुशी का सवाद सुन, श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ने कहा

verses.sloka: राघवे चार्थनिर्वृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः ।समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः कर्मसिद्धिभिरुन्नताः ।। ५.६१.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghave cārthanirvṛttiṁ kartuṁ ca paramaṁ yaśaḥ ।samādhāya samṛddhārthāḥ karmasiddhibhirunnatāḥ ।। 5.61.5 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

verses.sloka: प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः ।सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्विनः ।। ५.६१.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: priyākhyānonmukhāḥ sarve sarve yuddhābhinandinaḥ ।sarve rāmapratīkāre niścitārthā manasvinaḥ ।। 5.61.6 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.
translations.hindi: हे वानरो ! सीता देवो कहाँ हें और मेरे विषय में उनका मन कैसा है? सो तुम यह मब सोता का व॒त्तान्त मझसे कहो ।। प्‌) रामस्य गदित भुत्वा हरयो रामसन्निधौ । चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावत्तान्तकोविदम

verses.sloka: प्लवमानाः खमाप्लुत्य ततस्ते काननौकसः ।नन्दनोपममासेदुर्वनं द्रुमलतायुतम् ।। ५.६१.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: plavamānāḥ khamāplutya tataste kānanaukasaḥ ।nandanopamamāsedurvanaṁ drumalatāyutam ।। 5.61.7 ।।।।

translations.english: "The monkeys leaped into the sky and entered the garden that resembled the garden of Indra filled with trees and creepers.
translations.hindi: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्ये सीताये तां दिशं प्रति। \७॥। उन वानरों के वचन सुन पवननन्दन हनुमानजी ने दक्षिण दिशा की ओर मुख कर ग्रौर सीस नवाकर जानकी माता को प्रणाम किया

verses.sloka: यत्तन्मधुवनं नाम सुग्रीवस्याभिरक्षितम् ।अधृष्यं सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतमनोहरम् ।। ५.६१.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yattanmadhuvanaṁ nāma sugrīvasyābhirakṣitam ।adhṛṣyaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ sarvabhūtamanoharam ।। 5.61.8 ।।।।

translations.english: The Madhuvanam of Sugriva was wellprotected and was difficult to access for the vanaras. It was enchating to all beings.
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर बातचीत करने में चतुर हनुमानजी ने वह सारा वृत्तान्त कहा, जिस प्रकार उन्होंने सौताजी को देखा था । वे बोले हे राघव ! में शतयोजन समुद्र को लाँध कर

verses.sloka: यद्रक्षति महावीर्यः सदा दधिमुखः कपिः ।मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः ।। ५.६१.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadrakṣati mahāvīryaḥ sadā dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ ।mātulaḥ kapimukhyasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 5.61.9 ।।।।

translations.english: Dadhimukha, the foremost of all monkeys, of great valour and the maternal uncle of Sugriva was the caretaker of the garden.

verses.sloka: ते तद्वनमुपागम्य बभूवुः परमोत्कटाः ।वानरा वानरेन्द्रस्य मनः कान्ततमं महत् ।। ५.६१.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te tadvanamupāgamya babhūvuḥ paramotkaṭāḥ ।vānarā vānarendrasya manaḥ kāntatamaṁ mahat ।। 5.61.10 ।।।।

translations.english: On reaching the vanara king's extensive, delightful garden all the vanaras highly rejoiced.
translations.hindi: दक्षिण-समुद्र के दक्षिणी तट पर वह लंकानगरी बसी हुई है। उस नगरी में रावण के श्रन्तःपुर में मेंने पतिव्रता जानकी को देखा

verses.sloka: ततस्ते वानरा हृष्टा दृष्ट्वा मधुवनं महत् ।कुमारमभ्ययाचन्त मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः ।। ५.६१.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste vānarā hṛṣṭā dṛṣṭvā madhuvanaṁ mahat ।kumāramabhyayācanta madhūni madhupiṅgalāḥ ।। 5.61.11 ।।।।

translations.english: The honeycoloured monkeys felt happy on seeing the Madhuvanam and sought Angada's permission to drink honey.
translations.hindi: हे श्रीरामचन्द्रजी ! सीता केवल तुम्हारे दर्शन की श्राशा से जीवित है मेने उन्हें राक्षसियों के बीच बैठी हुई देखा । राक्षसियाँ बार-बार उन्हें डरा-धमका रही थीं

verses.sloka: ततः कुमारस्तान् वृद्धाञ्जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् कपीन् ।अनुमान्य ददौ तेषां निसर्गं मधुभक्षणे ।। ५.६१.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kumārastān vṛddhāñjāmbavatpramukhān kapīn ।anumānya dadau teṣāṁ nisargaṁ madhubhakṣaṇe ।। 5.61.12 ।।।।

translations.english: Young Angada asked old Jambavan's permission for the vanaras to drink honey and Jambavan permitted them.
translations.hindi: प्रमदावन में मु हजली राक्षसियाँ उनकी रखवाली किया करती हें । सीता- जी सदा तुम्हारे साय सुख भोगती रही हे; किन्तु इस समय वे दुःखी हो रही हें

verses.sloka: अङ्गदेनानुमतास्सन्तस्ततो मुदिताः तत्प्रेरिताः प्रनृत्यन्तो ऽभवन् ।। ५.६१.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: aṅgadenānumatāssantastato muditāḥ tatpreritāḥ pranṛtyanto 'bhavan ।। 5.61.13 ।।।।

translations.english: Permitted thus to drink honey the forestdwelling monkeys were motivated. They rejoiced very happily and started dancing.
translations.hindi: एक तो वे रावण के रनवास में कैद हैं, दूसरे राक्षसियां उनकी बड़ी सावधानी से चौकसी करती रहती हें । वे सिर के केशों को बाँध उन सब की एक चोटी बनाए हुए हे (अर्थात्‌ म्युङ्गार रहित हैं । ) वे सदा उदास रहती है भ्रौर तुम्हारा ही ध्यान किया करती हे

verses.sloka: गायन्ति केचित् प्रणमन्ति केचिन्नृत्यन्ति केचित् प्रहसन्ति केचित् ।पतन्ति केचिद्विचरन्ति केचित् प्लवन्ति केचित् प्रलपन्ति केचित् ।। ५.६१.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gāyanti kecit praṇamanti kecinnṛtyanti kecit prahasanti kecit ।patanti kecidvicaranti kecit plavanti kecit pralapanti kecit ।। 5.61.14 ।।।।

translations.english: Some sang, some prostrated on the ground, some danced, while some laughed, some jumped from the tree, some roamed about and some jumped up and down.
translations.hindi: वे पृथ्वी पर पड़ी रहती हे, उनका रंग वैसा ही फोका पड़ गया है जैसा कि, हेमन्त ऋतु में कमिलिनी का फीका पड़ जाता है । रावण से कछ भी सरोकार न रख, वे जान देने का निश्चय किए हुए हैं

verses.sloka: परस्परं केचिदुपाश्रयन्ते परस्परं केचिदुपाक्रमन्ते ।परस्परं केचिदुपब्रुवन्ते परस्परं केचिदुपारमन्ते ।। ५.६१.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: parasparaṁ kecidupāśrayante parasparaṁ kecidupākramante ।parasparaṁ kecidupabruvante parasparaṁ kecidupāramante ।। 5.61.15 ।।।।

translations.english: While some supported one another, some held each other, some exchanged secrets with one another, some entertained one another.

verses.sloka: द्रुमाद् द्रुमं केचिदभिद्रवन्ते क्षितौ नगाग्रान्निपतन्ति केचित् ।महीतलात् केचिदुदीर्णवेगा महाद्रुमाग्राण्यभिसम्पतन्ति ।। ५.६१.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: drumād drumaṁ kecidabhidravante kṣitau nagāgrānnipatanti kecit ।mahītalāt kecidudīrṇavegā mahādrumāgrāṇyabhisampatanti ।। 5.61.16 ।।।।

translations.english: While some ran from one tree to another, some jumped down from broken branches, and some swiftfooted ones fell down from the top of trees.
translations.hindi: है नरशाद्वल ! मेने उनका विश्वास अपने ऊपर जमा पाया । तदनन्तर उन देवो के साथ बातचीत कर उनको सव हाल कह सुनाया

verses.sloka: गायन्तमन्यः प्रहसन्नुपैति हसन्तमन्यः प्ररुदन्नुपैति ।रुदन्तमन्यः प्रणुदन्नुपैति नुदन्तमन्यः प्रणदन्नुपैति ।। ५.६१.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gāyantamanyaḥ prahasannupaiti hasantamanyaḥ prarudannupaiti ।rudantamanyaḥ praṇudannupaiti nudantamanyaḥ praṇadannupaiti ।। 5.61.17 ।।।।

translations.english: While one was singing, others approached him laughing while some were laughing others fell on them laughing excessively. While some were roaring, others went pushing them down. While some were encouraged to do something others shouted at them.
translations.hindi: व तुम्हारी और सुग्रीव की मैत्री का वत्तान्त सुन प्रसन्न हुईं । तुममें उनकी अनन्य भक्ति है और उनका पातिब्रत भी अटल बना हुआ है

verses.sloka: समाकुलं तत्कपिसैन्यमासीन्मधुप्रपानोत्कटसत्त्वचेष्टम् ।न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव मत्तो न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तृप्तः ।। ५.६१.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: samākulaṁ tatkapisainyamāsīnmadhuprapānotkaṭasattvaceṣṭam ।na cātra kaścinna babhūva matto na cātra kaścinna babhūva tṛptaḥ ।। 5.61.18 ।।।।

translations.english: The army of monkeys had lost control over their bodies due to drinking of honeywine. Not even one was quietly seated there. Not even one was not intoxicated. Not only that, none were satisfied.
translations.hindi: हे महाभाग ! ऐसी दशा में मैने जानकी को देखा है। हे पुरुषोत्तम ! तुमम उनकी बड़ी प्रीति है और वे कठोर तपस्या कर रहो हे- श्रर्थात्‌ बड़े कष्ट सह रही हैं

verses.sloka: ततो वनं तत्परिभक्ष्यमाणं द्रुमांश्च विध्वंसितपत्रपुष्पान् ।समीक्ष्य कोपदृधिवक्रनामा निवारयामास कपिः कपींस्तान् ।। ५.६१.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato vanaṁ tatparibhakṣyamāṇaṁ drumāṁśca vidhvaṁsitapatrapuṣpān ।samīkṣya kopadṛdhivakranāmā nivārayāmāsa kapiḥ kapīṁstān ।। 5.61.19 ।।।।

translations.english: Beholding the destruction wrought by the vanaras to the garden, trees, leaves and flowers, and having drunk all the honey, Dadhimukha angrily asked them to stop and get out.
translations.hindi: हे राघव ! हे महाप्राज्ञ ! चित्रकूट मे तुमने कौए के प्रति जो लीला की थी, वह सव मुझे चिल्लानी स्वरूप, तुमसे निवेदन करने को बतलाई है

verses.sloka: स तैः प्रवृद्धैः परिभर्त्स्यमानो वनस्य गोप्ता हरिवीरवृद्धः ।चकार भूयो मतिमुग्रतेजा वनस्य रक्षां प्रति वानरेभ्यः ।। ५.६१.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taiḥ pravṛddhaiḥ paribhartsyamāno vanasya goptā harivīravṛddhaḥ ।cakāra bhūyo matimugratejā vanasya rakṣāṁ prati vānarebhyaḥ ।। 5.61.20 ।।।।

translations.english: The elderly Dadhimukha who was the powerful protector of the garden reprimanded them and devised yet again a plan to protect it.
translations.hindi: ग्रौर हे नरव्याघ्र | मुझसे यह भी कहा है कि, जसा तुम यहाँ देखे जातेः हो वेसा ज्यों का त्यों तुम श्रोरामचन्द्रजी के श्रागे कह देना

verses.sloka: उवाच कांश्चित् परुषाणि धृष्टमसक्तमन्यांश्च तलैर्जवान ।समेत्य कैश्चित् कलहं चकार तथैव साम्नोपजगाम कंश्चित् ।। ५.६१.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: uvāca kāṁścit paruṣāṇi dhṛṣṭamasaktamanyāṁśca talairjavāna ।sametya kaiścit kalahaṁ cakāra tathaiva sāmnopajagāma kaṁścit ।। 5.61.21 ।।।।

translations.english: He spoke harshly to some, to others he asked not to talk, some he slapped on the hind part with the palm of his hand. To some he spoke pleasantly and with some he quarrelled. And to others he spoke in a conciliatory manner.
translations.hindi: श्रौर इस चूड़ामणि को, जिसे मॅने बड़े यत्न से वचा पाया है; श्रीरामचन्द्रजी को सुग्रीव के सामने देना श्रौर यह कहना 'कि मैने इस चूडामणि को प्रयत्न से सुरक्षित रखा है श्रौर उनसे कहना कि तिलक मिट जाने पर तुमने जो मेरे गण्डपाइव में मनसिल का तिलक लगाया था, उसका स्मरण तो तुमको श्रवश्य ही होगा । में ग्रंगूठी के बदले तुमको जलोत्पन्न चूडामणि भेजती हूं

verses.sloka: स तैर्मदात् सम्परिवार्य वाक्यैर्बलाच्च तेन प्रतिवार्यमाणैः ।प्रधर्षितस्त्यक्तभयैः समेत्य प्रकृष्यते चाप्यनवेक्ष्य दोषम् ।। ५.६१.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tairmadāt samparivārya vākyairbalācca tena prativāryamāṇaiḥ ।pradharṣitastyaktabhayaiḥ sametya prakṛṣyate cāpyanavekṣya doṣam ।। 5.61.22 ।।।।

translations.english: In their drunkenness they were using abusive language and with their strength they retaliated without fear. They invaded without considering their mistakes. They caught hold of Dadhimukha and pulled him.

verses.sloka: नखैस्तुदन्तो दशनैर्दशन्तस्तलैश्च पादैश्च समापयन्तः ।मदात् कपिं तं कपयः समग्रा महावनं निर्विषयं च चक्रुः ।। ५.६१.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: nakhaistudanto daśanairdaśantastalaiśca pādaiśca samāpayantaḥ ।madāt kapiṁ taṁ kapayaḥ samagrā mahāvanaṁ nirviṣayaṁ ca cakruḥ ।। 5.61.23 ।।

translations.english: In their drunkenness some monkeys scratched Dadhimukha violently with their nails, some bit him with their teeth and others slapped and kicked him with their palms and legs.Getting together they looted the garden completely. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकषष्टितम स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
